column1: # Stage S9 K0a: the in-place kernel cuts of the API, part one. Each future kernel crate's code moves
# into its own staging folder apps/api/src/kernel/<name>/ that imports only core and the kernel
# folders below it: the audit writers (audit_log), the member activity aggregates and queues
# (member_activity), and the caller authority checks (caller_identity). Whole files move here; the
# split items (AuditSeverity, TerrainType and GameMode, UserRole, arma_id_is_linked, the machine
# caller half of machine_credentials.rs and its tests) are cut by hand after the moves, and the
# mod declarations are edited by hand. Each module prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to the API
# source and one `api::` row scoped to the API package (integration tests, binaries, doc examples).
